temporal_state_chain.observed: Jonathan admits he has been keeping something from Christian and reveals that he is in some trouble and did not know how to tell him.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Christian believes Jonathan is hiding something important from him, which makes him anxious and suspicious.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes; Christian's suspicion is confirmed, and he learns that Jonathan is in trouble.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Jonathan has been hiding that he is in some kind of trouble.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To uncover the full truth about what Jonathan is hiding and what kind of trouble he is in.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Jonathan says the situation is complicated, does not want to drag Christian into it, but accepts that he could use support and resources to get out of the mess.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Jonathan is in trouble and has been hiding details from Christian.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes; Jonathan accepts Christian's offer of help and admits he needs support and resources.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Jonathan is in serious trouble and needs Christian's help to resolve it.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To offer help and support Jonathan in getting out of his trouble.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Jonathan says he cannot be sure but might have gotten involved with the wrong people, though he denies doing anything illegal himself.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Jonathan is in trouble and needs help, and Christian suspects the trouble may be related to criminal activity.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes; Christian's suspicion is partly confirmed: Jonathan may be connected to dangerous or criminal people, but Jonathan denies committing an illegal act.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Jonathan's trouble likely involves criminal or dangerous people, though Jonathan may not be guilty of a crime himself.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To investigate the matter discreetly without alarming Jonathan.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Christian's investigation reveals that Jonathan is being framed and that someone is trying to set him up; Christian has some leads.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Jonathan may be entangled with the wrong people and needs help, but the full truth is unclear.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes; Christian learns that Jonathan is being framed rather than being guilty.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Jonathan is innocent and is being framed by an unknown person.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To clear Jonathan's name by gathering evidence that proves his innocence.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Christian tells Jonathan that he has found out who is behind the frame-up: it is someone both of them know and trust.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Jonathan is being framed by an unknown person, and Christian is gathering evidence to prove Jonathan's innocence.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes; Christian identifies that the real culprit is someone close to both him and Jonathan.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Someone close to both Christian and Jonathan is the real culprit and has betrayed them.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To confront the real culprit and bring them to justice.
